forbiddenInputs: brightness, characteristics, evidence, or neighboring fields
inputBoundary.originalValuePreservation: Retain the exact canonical raw value and its SHA-256. Parsing may use a trimmed case-folded working copy but may not replace the retained value.

ruleOrder: exact whole-token or controlled packed-token color categories
appearance or luminosity descriptor without a color category

prohibitions: The source column name Color does not establish an object or emitted-light role.
Luminous, bright, fiery, shiny, metallic, transparent, translucent, reflective, clear, and dark do not establish an emitted-light or object-surface role.
A role may not be inferred from descriptions or neighboring fields.
Rows with both cue families remain ambiguous instead of being forced into either role.

controlledPackedTokens.strategy: After punctuation removal and case folding, accept a value only when the complete string can be segmented into registered color aliases and registered non-color modifiers. Partial substring matches are forbidden.

structuralRules.compoundRule: Two or more distinct parsed categories are explicit_compound. Repeated synonyms of one category remain exact_single.
structuralRules.changingRule: A changing marker with categories is changing_known; without categories it is changing_unspecified.
structuralRules.multicolorRule: A multicolor marker with fewer than two explicit categories is multicolor_unspecified.

releaseAccounting.normalizedRowDefinition: parse status is one of normalizedStatuses; descriptors, sentinels, missing values, and unparsed text do not count
releaseAccounting.roleCompatibleComparison: Only like-for-like role codes may be compared. role_unspecified may be described and compared only as source-reported color with unspecified role; it may never be relabeled object color or emitted-light color.

requiredFailClosedTests: raw value and raw-value SHA-256 are exact
source occurrence counts equal the governing audit
all accepted categories consume whole tokens or a complete registered UFOCAT packed value
descriptors without categories do not count as normalized
missing and sentinel values never become negative observations
object and light roles are never inferred from the Color field name
unknown role remains unknown in projections, estimators, UI, and exports
